Policies and Initiatives.title: Kerala CM launches State’s first ‘Lab on Wheels’ mobile technology laboratory
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Kerala's Chief Minister has launched the state's first "Lab on Wheels" mobile technology laboratory. The lab is a joint initiative of ASAP Kerala and Infosys Springboard, aiming to introduce students to emerging technologies. The lab will focus on technologies such as AI and robotics, targeting school and college students in Kerala.

Policies and Initiatives.title: ARISE hubs to come up in high schools in Kerala: Minister
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Kerala will establish ARISE hubs in high schools to promote AI and robotics in education. These hubs aim to expand the possibilities of AI and robotics in learning and experimentation. The initiative is part of the AI & Robotics Initiative for School Education.

Events.title: Regional AI Conference at Thiruvananthapuram
Events.summary: A regional AI conference is being held in Thiruvananthapuram, bringing together experts and enthusiasts to discuss artificial intelligence. The conference aims to promote knowledge sharing and collaboration in the field of AI. Details about the conference, including its schedule and speakers, are not specified.

Major AI Developments.title: Case registered over fake AI video of top Kerala cop
Major AI Developments.summary: Kerala Police have registered a cyber fraud case over an AI-generated fake video impersonating ADGP P Vijayan, which promoted an old currency note scam on Facebook. The video is being investigated, along with the account that posted it and potential victims. Police are also checking for similar deepfake videos targeting other officials.

Major AI Developments.title: In AI era, IT sector employees facing an uncertain future
Major AI Developments.summary: The IT sector is facing uncertainty due to the AI era, with over 1,000 employees recently laid off from two firms in Kerala. This has sparked concern among employees and stakeholders about the future of the industry. The layoffs have prompted an examination of the challenges affecting the sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Jeddah-bound AI Express flight from Kerala’s Kannur turns back due to engine fault
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI Express flight from Kerala's Kannur to Jeddah turned back due to an engine fault. The aircraft, carrying over 180 passengers, took off at 7:40 am but returned after about two hours when pilots noticed an engine warning light. The flight safely returned to Kannur airport, according to airport sources.

Major AI Developments.title: Kerala High Court wins e-governance award
Major AI Developments.summary: The Kerala High Court's Department of Computerization and Management Services (DCMS) has received a Gold Award for innovation in using AI and new age technologies to provide citizen-centric services. The award was given among 104 entries in the category of "Innovation by Use of AI and Other New Age Technologies for Providing Citizen-centric Services". This recognition highlights the court's efforts in leveraging technology to enhance e-governance.

Major AI Developments.title: Thikkodiyan, Uroob, and K. Raghavan back on AIR, thanks to AI
Major AI Developments.summary: The voices of writers Thikkodiyan and Uroob, and composer K. Raghavan, were recreated using AI for a play broadcast on All India Radio. The original voices were sourced from the AIR archives and used in a play as part of the All Kerala Radio Drama Festival. The festival was revived after an eight-year hiatus.

Major AI Developments.title: Cardiologists’ meet in Kerala’s Thrissur showcases future of cardiac care
Major AI Developments.summary: Cardiologists gathered in Thrissur, Kerala, to discuss the future of cardiac care, highlighting advancements in AI-driven diagnosis and minimally invasive procedures. The meeting showcased next-generation cardiac devices and their potential to revolutionize heart treatment. Experts emphasized the role of technology in improving cardiac care and patient outcomes.

Major AI Developments.title: Kochi NGO Maithri receives distress calls via AI referrals
Major AI Developments.summary: Kochi-based NGO Maithri is utilizing AI technology to receive distress calls. The AI system refers individuals in need to the NGO, providing them with support and assistance. This innovative approach enables Maithri to expand its reach and provide help to those who require it.

Major AI Developments.title: Kerala deploys AI surveillance for polls; real-time alerts track queues, crowd at booths
Major AI Developments.summary: Kerala is utilizing AI-powered surveillance for the upcoming polls, enabling real-time monitoring of queues and crowds at polling stations. Live webcasting has been set up in all polling stations, with two cameras installed at each location, one inside and one outside. This technology aims to enhance the efficiency and transparency of the voting process on April 9.

Major AI Developments.title: Kerala cyber police file case against X over ‘defamatory’ AI video on PM, ECI
Major AI Developments.summary: Kerala cyber police have filed a case against an individual, referred to as X, over a allegedly defamatory AI-generated video targeting the Prime Minister and the Election Commission of India. A case has also been registered against the X account associated with the video. The action was taken in response to the video's purportedly defamatory content.

Major AI Developments.title: Elon Musk's X platform under police radar: Kerala takes action on AI generated misinformation - Check details
Major AI Developments.summary: Kerala Police have taken action against Elon Musk's X platform over an AI-generated video that allegedly defames Narendra Modi and the Election Commission of India. The move aims to mitigate the risks of misinformation and its potential impact on free and fair elections. The case highlights concerns over AI-generated content spreading false information on social media platforms.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: UDF promises sweeping reforms in Kerala’s higher education sector
Major AI Developments.summary: The UDF has unveiled a new policy framework for Kerala's higher education sector, focusing on student welfare, university autonomy, and AI integration. The proposed reforms aim to bring about significant changes in the state's education system. Key areas of focus include improving student facilities and introducing artificial intelligence to enhance the learning experience.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sports-tech startup Dartle raises $100K in seed funding led by IPV
AI Start-Up News.summary: Kerala-based sports-tech startup Dartle has raised $100,000 in seed funding led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand its market presence, particularly in the US, and enhance its AI integrations. Dartle operates a B2B SaaS platform for youth sports and football academies, currently serving 14 academies across India and the Middle East.

AI Start-Up News.title: IAN Alpha Fund leads Rs 22 Cr round in deep-tech startup RoshAi
AI Start-Up News.summary: RoshAi, a deep-tech autonomy company, has raised Rs 22 crore ($2.36 million) in a funding round led by IAN Group's Alpha Fund. The Kochi-based startup had previously raised $1.71 million in seed funding from investors including Caret Capital and Ev2 Ventures. The fresh funds will be used to strengthen its product and expand its presence in global industrial markets.
